zh.plugin_intro_content:
欢迎使用倒计时插件系统！

您可以通过编写 Python 插件来扩展自定义控件。
插件文件放置在程序目录下的 plugins 文件夹中，
遵循示例模板即可注册新的动态背景或自定义小挂件。

详细开发文档请参考项目主页。

zh.welcome_msg:
欢迎使用倒计时桌面应用！

核心功能：
• 右键悬浮窗打开菜单
• 自定义外观编辑器调整布局
• 插件系统扩展功能
• 壁纸选择器管理桌面壁纸

详细使用方法请查看帮助页面。
zh.theme_restart_hint: 主题已更改，需要重启应用才能完全生效。是否立即重启？
zh.render_restart_hint: 渲染后端已更改，需要重启应用才能生效。是否立即重启？
zh.render_intel_tip: 集成显卡建议使用 Direct3D 11、OpenGL 或软件渲染
zh.perm_scope_FILE_READ: 仅限插件打开的文件与目录
zh.perm_scope_FILE_WRITE: 仅限插件打开或创建的文件与目录
zh.perm_scope_FILE_DELETE: 仅限插件可访问的文件与目录
zh.perm_name_NETWORK: 访问网络（含 HTTP 与 Socket）
zh.perm_scope_NETWORK: 网络连接、HTTP 请求与原始 Socket
zh.perm_scope_COMMAND: 系统命令与外部程序调用
zh.perm_scope_SYSTEM_INFO: 系统目录、Program Files 与 ProgramData
zh.perm_scope_AUTOSTART: 启动文件夹与宿主代写的 Run 键
zh.perm_scope_UI_READ: 窗口列表、主题参数与已注册插槽，只读
zh.perm_name_UI_MUTATE: 改写控件类与运行时替换
zh.perm_scope_UI_MUTATE: 宿主或插件控件类的类属性、类方法与运行时替换；只改实例不需要此权限
zh.perm_name_PLUGIN_CALL: 调用其他插件提供的服务
zh.perm_scope_PLUGIN_CALL: 对方清单中声明公开的服务，调用方与被调用方都需同意
zh.perm_name_PLUGIN_DATA_SHARE: 读写其他插件导出的数据
zh.perm_scope_PLUGIN_DATA_SHARE: 跨插件数据共享预留权限位；当前版本没有 exports.data 文件共享接口
zh.perm_dialog_baseline_subtitle: 这些权限用于插件的基础功能，启用时一次性确认。
zh.perm_dialog_ondemand_subtitle: 插件仅在需要时申请这项权限；你可以选择授权范围。
zh.perm_dialog_legacy_notice: 该插件使用旧版权限声明，已自动迁移：低风险与中风险权限归入基础权限，高风险权限转为按需申请。
zh.perm_reason_missing: 插件未提供具体用途说明。
zh.perm_reason_baseline_demoted: 插件声明为基础权限，但风险较高，已转为按需授权。
zh.perm_reason_legacy_missing: 插件在旧版本中声明了该权限，但未提供用途说明。
zh.perm_reason_baseline_truncated: 基础权限超过 12 项上限，该项按风险顺序被转为按需授权。
zh.perm_dialog_hint: “拒绝并记住”会持续拦截该权限，可在安全中心撤销；取消或关闭只跳过本次并进入 5 分钟冷却。
zh.perm_footer_baseline: 暂不允许会取消本次启用；已授权的档位可随时在插件安全中心撤回，关闭程序后本次会话授权自动失效。
zh.perm_footer_ondemand: 暂不允许只会跳过本次「{feature}」，不会自动重试；可在插件安全中心重新授权。
zh.perm_card_blocked: 操作已被拦截，限制来自{layer}。若该限制可由你放开，授权后本次操作会自动继续，无需重试。
zh.perm_card_consequence_intercept: 继续阻止只会跳过本次「{feature}」，5 分钟内不再询问。
zh.perm_card_consequence_explicit: 不允许只会跳过本次「{feature}」，不会自动重试。
zh.perm_card_more: 按 Enter 打开更多选项，按 Esc 关闭
zh.perm_grant_hint: 允许一次：成功执行一次后立即失效；本会话：退出程序后失效；永久允许：重启后仍然有效；拒绝并记住：持续拦截该权限，直至手动撤销。
zh.perm_layer_L0: 无需限制：已在允许范围内
zh.perm_layer_L2: 授权层：用户未授权或已拒绝
zh.perm_layer_L3: 范围层：目标位于保护区
zh.perm_layer_L4: 强制层：硬性规则，不开放
zh.perm_tag_granted_retry: 已授权，本次操作自动继续
zh.perm_observe_notice: 观察模式：以下操作按新规则本应被拦截，当前仅记录未拦截
zh.perm_restore_select_plugin: 请先切换到“按插件视角”并选择一个插件。
zh.perm_restore_not_legacy: 插件「{name}」使用的不是旧版权限声明，无需恢复。
zh.perm_restore_confirm_text: 确定要恢复插件「{name}」在旧版本中声明的全部权限吗？
zh.perm_restore_confirm_info:
将一次性授予 {count} 项权限（含高风险项）：{names}
恢复后这些权限为“永久允许”，插件运行时不会再逐项询问。请仅在确认该插件可信时使用。
zh.perm_restore_log_action: 安全中心操作：恢复旧版全部权限
zh.perm_restore_verify_title: 恢复旧版权限 · 身份验证
zh.perm_restore_verify_heading: 即将恢复插件「{name}」的全部权限
zh.perm_restore_verify_body:
该插件使用旧版权限声明，已被拆分为“基础权限 + 按需权限”。
恢复后会一次性授予全部 {count} 项权限并记为永久允许：
{names}

这会跳过逐项按需申请，仅在确认插件来源可信时使用。
zh.perm_restore_verify_hint: 验证码用于阻止脚本或插件自动提升权限。
zh.perm_restore_done_desc: 插件已获得旧版本声明的全部权限，可在本页随时逐项撤销。
zh.perm_request_max_three: request_permissions 一次最多申请 3 项权限
zh.perm_msg_undeclared: 插件未在清单中声明该权限
zh.perm_msg_denied_remember: 该权限已被拒绝并记住
zh.perm_enable_denied_remember: 基础权限已被拒绝并记住，需先在安全中心撤销
zh.perm_enable_cancelled: 未授予基础权限，已取消启用

en.plugin_intro_content:
Welcome to the Countdown Plugin System!

You can extend the app by writing Python plugins.
Place your .py files in the 'plugins' folder next to the executable.
Follow the example template to register custom dynamic backgrounds or widgets.

See the project homepage for detailed documentation.
en.update_in_dev_msg:
The update check feature is under development.
Please follow the release page for the latest version.
en.arrow_keys_resize: Use arrow keys to resize (Shift for larger steps)
en.poem_level_moved: Poem level moved to Skin Editor → Verse Flow
en.backup_success: Config backed up to backups/ directory
en.restore_success: Config restored, please restart the app
en.welcome_msg:
Welcome to Countdown Desktop App!

Core features:
• Right-click the floating window for menu
• Appearance Editor for layout customization
• Plugin system for extended functionality
• Wallpaper Selector for desktop wallpaper management

See the Help page for detailed usage.
en.theme_restart_hint: Theme changed. A restart is required to fully apply. Restart now?
en.render_restart_hint: Render backend changed. A restart is required to take effect. Restart now?
en.render_intel_tip: Integrated graphics: Direct3D 11, OpenGL or Software recommended
en.perm_scope_FILE_READ: Reads project folders, plugin data and paths you approve, excluding sensitive system files.
en.perm_scope_FILE_WRITE: Writes project data, plugin settings and paths you approve.
en.perm_scope_FILE_DELETE: Deletes only files the plugin created or files you approved.
en.perm_scope_NETWORK: Connects to the internet while the plugin is running.
en.perm_scope_NETWORK_HTTP: Sends HTTP/HTTPS requests to addresses declared by the plugin.
en.perm_scope_NETWORK_SOCKET: Opens raw TCP/UDP sockets, including DNS lookups.
en.perm_scope_COMMAND: Runs system commands; blocked unless you grant this permission.
en.perm_scope_COMMAND_EXEC: Starts external programs declared by the plugin.
en.perm_scope_PROCESS_SPAWN: Creates child processes and manages their lifetime.
en.perm_scope_CLIPBOARD: Reads and writes clipboard text while the plugin is active.
en.perm_scope_SYSTEM_INFO: Reads system version, display and hardware details.
en.perm_scope_NOTIFICATION: Shows desktop notifications through the host.
en.perm_scope_UI_INJECT: Adds widgets or panels to the host interface.
en.perm_scope_EVENT_LISTEN: Subscribes to countdown and application events.
en.perm_scope_THREAD_SPAWN: Runs background threads while the plugin is active.
en.perm_scope_REGISTRY: Reads or writes Windows registry keys declared by the plugin.
en.perm_scope_ENV_READ: Reads environment variables such as paths and system settings.
en.perm_scope_DANGEROUS_EVAL: Executes code generated at runtime; high risk.
en.perm_scope_AUTOSTART: Writes only to the Startup folder and Run/RunOnce keys, never other registry areas.
en.perm_scope_PLUGIN_SOURCE: Reads the source of other plugins; this permission alone unlocks it.
en.perm_scope_UI_READ: Window list, theme values and registered slots; read-only.
en.perm_scope_UI_MUTATE: Class attributes, class methods and runtime replacement on host or plugin widget classes; instance-only changes need no permission.
en.perm_scope_PLUGIN_CALL: Only services published in the provider manifest; both sides must agree.
en.perm_name_PLUGIN_DATA_SHARE: Read or write data exported by other plugins
en.perm_scope_PLUGIN_DATA_SHARE: Reserved permission bit for cross-plugin data sharing; this version has no exports.data file-sharing interface
en.perm_dialog_baseline_title: "{name}" requests the permissions required to start
en.perm_dialog_baseline_subtitle: These permissions power the plugin's basic features and are confirmed once when it starts.
en.perm_dialog_ondemand_subtitle: The plugin asks for this permission only when needed; you choose the grant scope.
en.perm_dialog_legacy_notice: This plugin uses a legacy permission declaration and was migrated automatically: low- and medium-risk permissions became basic, high-risk ones became on-demand.
en.perm_reason_missing: The plugin did not explain what this is used for.
en.perm_reason_baseline_demoted: Declared as a basic permission but high-risk, so it was moved to on-demand.
en.perm_reason_legacy_missing: Declared in an older plugin version without an explanation.
en.perm_reason_baseline_truncated: Basic permissions exceeded the limit of 12, so this item was moved to on-demand by risk order.
en.perm_dialog_hint: "Deny and remember" keeps blocking this permission until you revoke it in the security center; cancel or close skips just this request and starts a 5-minute cooldown.
en.perm_footer_baseline: Choosing not to allow cancels this start; grants can be revoked in the plugin security center, and session grants end when the app closes.
en.perm_footer_ondemand: Declining skips only this "{feature}" attempt with no automatic retry; you can grant it later in the plugin security center.
en.perm_card_blocked: The action was blocked; the restriction comes from {layer}. If you can unlock it, this operation continues automatically after granting, with no retry needed.
en.perm_card_consequence_intercept: Keeping it blocked skips only this "{feature}" attempt and stops prompts for 5 minutes.
en.perm_card_consequence_explicit: Declining skips only this "{feature}" attempt with no automatic retry.
en.perm_card_more: Press Enter for more options, Esc to close
en.perm_grant_hint: Allow once: expires after one successful call; This session: expires when the app exits; Always allow: survives restarts; Deny and remember: keeps blocking until you revoke it.
en.perm_layer_L0: No restriction: already within the allowed range
en.perm_layer_L1: Declaration: not declared in the manifest
en.perm_layer_L2: Grant: not granted or denied by the user
en.perm_layer_L3: Scope: the target is in a protected zone
en.perm_observe_notice: Observation mode: the operations below would be blocked under the new rules; currently only recorded
en.perm_restore_select_plugin: Switch to the per-plugin view and select a plugin first.
en.perm_restore_not_legacy: "{name}" does not use a legacy permission declaration, so there is nothing to restore.
en.perm_restore_confirm_text: Restore all permissions declared by "{name}" in its legacy version?
en.perm_restore_confirm_info:
This grants {count} permissions at once, including high-risk ones: {names}
They become "Always allow" and the plugin will not ask again. Use this only if you trust the plugin.
en.perm_restore_log_action: Security center: restore all legacy permissions
en.perm_restore_verify_heading: About to restore all permissions for "{name}"
en.perm_restore_verify_body:
This plugin uses a legacy declaration that was split into basic and on-demand permissions.
Restoring grants all {count} permissions permanently:
{names}

This bypasses on-demand requests. Use it only if you trust the plugin's source.
en.perm_restore_verify_hint: The code prevents scripts or plugins from escalating permissions automatically.
en.perm_restore_done_desc: The plugin now has every permission it declared before; you can revoke them individually here at any time.
en.perm_request_max_three: request_permissions accepts at most 3 permissions at a time
en.perm_retry_hint: ; the grant was approved, please retry the action
en.perm_msg_undeclared: The plugin did not declare this permission in its manifest
en.perm_msg_denied_remember: This permission was denied and remembered
en.perm_enable_denied_remember: A basic permission was denied and remembered; revoke it in the security center first
en.perm_enable_cancelled: No basic permission was granted, so enabling was cancelled
